## Summary
Implement a deterministic Fisher-Yates shuffle seeded by HMAC-SHA256(secret, student_id:exam_id) so each student sees a unique but reproducible item order during exams.

## User story
As an exam administrator, I want each student to see assessment items in a unique scrambled order, so that cheating by sharing answers with neighbors is mitigated while maintaining reproducibility for audits.

## Why this matters
Without deterministic scrambling, either all students see the same order (cheating risk) or the order is random and non-reproducible (audit failure under LCME). The HMAC-SHA256 seed ensures every student gets a unique permutation that can be exactly recreated for grade disputes or FERPA audits.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] seededShuffle(items, seed) produces a Fisher-Yates permutation in O(n)
- [ ] HMAC-SHA256(EXAM_SCRAMBLE_SECRET, student_id:exam_id) generates the seed
- [ ] Same inputs always produce the same output (deterministic)
- [ ] Different student_ids produce different orderings for the same exam
- [ ] EXAM_SCRAMBLE_SECRET is 32+ bytes, stored in Supabase Vault, never in env vars
- [ ] ScramblerService.scrambleForStudent(sessionItems, studentId, examId) returns reordered items
- [ ] Scrambled positions are written back to session_items.position column
- [ ] Unit tests verify determinism, uniqueness, and uniform distribution

## Code patterns to follow
```typescript
// shared/utils/seeded-shuffle.ts
import { createHmac } from 'crypto';

/**
 * Seeded PRNG from HMAC-SHA256 digest.
 * Consumes 4 bytes per random number from the 32-byte digest,
 * re-hashing when exhausted.
 */
class SeededRng {
  private buffer: Buffer;
  private offset: number;
  private counter: number;
  private seed: Buffer;

  constructor(seed: Buffer) {
    this.seed = seed;
    this.counter = 0;
    this.buffer = seed;
    this.offset = 0;
  }

  next(): number {
    if (this.offset + 4 > this.buffer.length) {
      this.counter++;
      this.buffer = createHmac('sha256', this.seed)
        .update(Buffer.from([this.counter]))
        .digest();
      this.offset = 0;
    }
    const val = this.buffer.readUInt32BE(this.offset) / 0x100000000;
    this.offset += 4;
    return val; // [0, 1)
  }
}

export function seededShuffle<T>(items: T[], seed: Buffer): T[] {
  const arr = [...items]; // never mutate original
  const rng = new SeededRng(seed);
  // Fisher-Yates (Knuth) shuffle — O(n)
  for (let i = arr.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
    const j = Math.floor(rng.next() * (i + 1));
    [arr[i], arr[j]] = [arr[j], arr[i]];
  }
  return arr;
}

// features/exam-delivery/services/ScramblerService.ts
import { createHmac } from 'crypto';
import { createServerClient } from '@journey/db/client';
import { seededShuffle } from '@/shared/utils/seeded-shuffle';

export class ScramblerService {
  async scrambleForStudent(
    sessionItems: { id: string; assessment_item_id: string }[],
    studentId: string,
    examId: string
  ) {
    // Fetch secret from Supabase Vault
    const supabase = createServerClient();
    const { data: secret } = await supabase.rpc('vault_read_secret', {
      secret_name: 'EXAM_SCRAMBLE_SECRET'
    });

    const seed = createHmac('sha256', secret)
      .update(`${studentId}:${examId}`)
      .digest();

    const scrambled = seededShuffle(sessionItems, seed);

    // Update positions in session_items
    const updates = scrambled.map((item, idx) => ({
      id: item.id,
      position: idx + 1,
    }));

    // Batch update positions
    for (const update of updates) {
      await supabase
        .from('session_items')
        .update({ position: update.position })
        .eq('id', update.id);
    }

    return scrambled;
  }
}
```

}

## Automated tests (Playwright — runs during /validate)
```typescript
// tests/E07/E07-S03.unit.test.ts
import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test';
import { seededShuffle } from '@/shared/utils/seeded-shuffle';
import { createHmac } from 'crypto';

const testSecret = Buffer.from('a'.repeat(32));
const items = Array.from({ length: 50 }, (_, i) => ({ id: `item-${i}`, position: i }));

test('seededShuffle is deterministic — same seed produces same order', () => {
  const seed = createHmac('sha256', testSecret).update('student1:exam1').digest();
  const result1 = seededShuffle(items, seed);
  const result2 = seededShuffle(items, seed);
  expect(result1.map(i => i.id)).toEqual(result2.map(i => i.id));
});

test('seededShuffle produces different orders for different students', () => {
  const seed1 = createHmac('sha256', testSecret).update('student1:exam1').digest();
  const seed2 = createHmac('sha256', testSecret).update('student2:exam1').digest();
  const result1 = seededShuffle(items, seed1);
  const result2 = seededShuffle(items, seed2);
  expect(result1.map(i => i.id)).not.toEqual(result2.map(i => i.id));
});

test('seededShuffle does not mutate original array', () => {
  const original = [...items];
  const seed = createHmac('sha256', testSecret).update('student1:exam1').digest();
  seededShuffle(items, seed);
  expect(items).toEqual(original);
});

test('seededShuffle preserves all items (no duplicates, no drops)', () => {
  const seed = createHmac('sha256', testSecret).update('student1:exam1').digest();
  const result = seededShuffle(items, seed);
  expect(result.length).toBe(items.length);
  const ids = new Set(result.map(i => i.id));
  expect(ids.size).toBe(items.length);
});
```
